use System.Math
use Raster.IMAGE

let size = 256

shade(value: int, phase: double) -> ubyte =>
    cast ubyte(
        127.5D * (1.0D - Math.cos(
            2.0D * Math.pi * cast double(value) / 256.0D + phase
        ))
    )

let image = IMAGE(size, size)

for y in 0..size do
    for x in 0..size do
        let value = x ^ y

        image.set_pixel(
            x, y,
            shade(value, 0.0D),
            shade(value, 2.1D),
            shade(value, 4.2D)
        )
    od
od

image.write("munching.png")

image.show("munching.png")
